title: Ethics by Configuration: AI Ethics Principles in Coding Agent Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2610.34847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI coding agents become integral to software development, projects increasingly utilise configuration files, such as context files and skills, to govern agent behaviour. While AI ethics principles are widely used in research and policy, little is known about whether and how they are reflected when developers configure coding agents. We studied ethics principles in 40,079 configuration files across 8,893 GitHub repositories. Using a validated large language model (LLM) classification, we measured the prevalence of ethics-related statements, and qualitatively analysed 702 stratified samples across 679 files to uncover the ethical considerations reflected in these files and the parties they concern. Ethics-related statements appeared in 39.4% of files and 61.5% of repositories; concentrated on accountability, transparency, privacy protection, and reliability; and occurred more often in task-specific files such as skills than in project-w

translated_title: 基于配置的伦理：编码智能体指令中的AI伦理原则
translated_abstract: 随着AI编码智能体成为软件开发中不可或缺的一部分，项目越来越多地利用配置文件（如上下文文件和技能文件）来规范智能体的行为。尽管AI伦理原则在研究和政策中被广泛使用，但关于开发者在配置编码智能体时是否以及如何体现这些原则，目前知之甚少。我们研究了8,893个GitHub仓库中40,079个配置文件里的伦理原则。通过使用经过验证的大语言模型（LLM）分类方法，我们测量了伦理相关声明的普遍程度，并对679个文件中的702个分层样本进行了定性分析，以揭示这些文件所反映的伦理考量及其涉及的各方。研究发现，伦理相关声明出现在39.4%的文件和61.5%的仓库中；主要集中于问责、透明度、隐私保护和可靠性方面；并且在技能等任务特定文件中比在全项目范围文件中更常出现。
tldr: 该研究通过分析8,893个GitHub仓库中的40,079个配置文件，首次系统揭示了开发者在配置AI编码智能体时会自发写入伦理相关声明（见于39.4%的文件），且这些声明集中于问责、透明度、隐私保护和可靠性四大原则。
en_tdlr: This study systematically reveals that developers embed ethics-related statements—concentrated on accountability, transparency, privacy protection, and reliability—into AI coding agent configurations, with 39.4% of the 40,079 analyzed files across 8,893 GitHub repositories containing such principles.
